en: HAHAHA! Where'd your previous{SAUT}vigor go?
Ngh... I don't want to believe it, but{SAUT}are we really unable to defy him!?
Ain't there anything we can do?
Oh no―if this keeps up...
...Hey, Noir. Do you remember what{SAUT}that policeman said earlier?{PAGE}"As long as we still have 'that' around,{SAUT}Kamoshidaman is invincible."
Oh, you're right!{PAGE}So that means there's something making{SAUT}Kamoshidaman untouchable?
Did you notice how the eyes of the{SAUT}statue shine when everyone becomes{SAUT}immobile?
So, it's possible that they need{SAUT}to target...
Yes―the statue!
HAHAHA! Of course you can't win{SAUT}against me―I am absolutely just!
I don't think you're just at all!{PAGE}You don't even listen to anyone else―{SAUT}you only judge people by your own{SAUT}standards!
Ha! So it's true when they say that{SAUT}losers have the biggest mouths!{PAGE}Evildoers threatening society shall{SAUT}perish: this is the law of Kamo City!
Guys! That Kamoshidaman statue{SAUT}is the reason you can't move!
Wh-Wh-What!?
Huh? That butt-ugly statue?
Wh-Wh-Wh-What're you talking{SAUT}about!? Th-Th-The statue is wholly{SAUT}unrelated to my power!
He's really squirming there...{SAUT}Did they nail it!?
So, we're to destroy that statue?
But, we can't move like we need to...{PAGE}And it's way too far to target from here.{SAUT}What should we do, Joker?
We have to retreat for now.{OPTION}Do something about it.{OPTION}Give it everything you've got!
Mm, that's a wise decision. Let's retreat{SAUT}so we can gain an advantage.
And what would that be!?
I think we should retreat so we can{SAUT}gain an advantage.
Alright, then! One, two―
―Wait, ain't that what we're already{SAUT}effin' doing!?
I think we should retreat so we can{SAUT}gain an advantage.
Tch! I guess we got no other choice!{SAUT}But...
Everyone, go! We'll be fine!
Sorry―sit tight, we'll definitely be{SAUT}back to rescue you!
We'll return soon!
You think I'd let you scum merely flee?{SAUT}Guards―seize the evildoers!
They're coming! What do we do!?
Ha, we're not gettin' caught by some{SAUT}small fries!
Right! The escape route's this way!
An escape route? Wow! That sounds{SAUT}like real phantom thief business!
It's not LIKE it―we ARE the Phantom{SAUT}Thieves.
Oh, save it―we've gotta run!
So they got away... Well, no matter.
Loyal citizens! The evil plaguing you has{SAUT}fled, tails between their legs, thanks{SAUT}to my absolute justice!
Woooah!
Now that's our Kamoshidaman!
Kamoshidaman was right after all!
HAHAHAHAHA! Justice always wins!
We have faith in you guys!
